title: What Scripture Actually Means by Self-Control
caption:
Most guys think self-control means gritting your teeth and holding the line. That's exhausting, and it's not what the word means. It runs out by Thursday.

Galatians 5:23 lists self-control after love, joy, peace, patience. It's not a muscle you flex. It's a fruit that grows out of who's actually running you.

A tree doesn't force its fruit. It grows it, slowly, because of what's feeding the root. Your 1 a.m. problem is usually a 7 a.m. problem in disguise. Feed the root, not the fight.

#faith #selfcontrol #godlyman #christianmen #scripture
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
